thread:
Sam: Heads-up 1: were coordinating a staggered marketplace roll for H100/H200/B200, MI300, and Gaudi. Need a short sync on embargo windows + SI gating per region.
Priya: 👍 Agree. Key constraint: SI cert + FW smoke in each region before marketplace SKU flips. No half-announces.
Carlos: SI update: H100/H200 driver bits are green for NA/EU, MI300 has a perf regression in EU microbenchmarks, Gaudi FW hit an ACL bug that may push APAC by ~9-12 days.
Renee: Marketing: if APAC slips we need a separate press window. We can do NA/EU first but the marketplace listing must not imply global availability.
Sam: Proposed staggered cadence (draft):
```
- NA/EU: H100/H200 -> announce week of 2026-06-07 (SI cert + canary pass)
- Global: B200 -> announce week of 2026-06-14 (driver pinned)
- EU/APAC: MI300 -> announce earliest 2026-06-21 (perf hold)
- APAC: Gaudi -> canary only until SI smoke cleared
```
Priya: Ops note: we should enable region-gated SKU flags and add a marketplace "coming soon" state for others.
Carlos: Action from SI: I'll publish the updated test grid by EOD today and flag any lanes failing perf by >5%. Expect Gaudi ACL patch early next week.
DevOpsBot: Alert: capacity reservations required for canary pools. Create ticket infra#9876 to allocate 3x GPUs in APAC staging.
Renee: MarketingLead: I'll draft two embargo notes: one for NA/EU, one for the later APAC wave. Legal wants explicit wording around "region-limited availability".
Sam: Quick checklist:
- SI: confirm cert dates per region (Carlos)
- Ops: create canary Dedicated pools + tag marketplace routes (Priya / DevOps)
- Runtime: prepare auto-fallback to quantized variants if perf regresses (Sam / Runtime)
- Marketing: embargo drafts + press timing (Renee)
Carlos: Note: if MI300 perf fix takes longer we can still offer a temporary rate-limited instance in EU with a "beta" tag to reduce support noise.
Priya: Good call. We'll gate it behind opt-in in Console and add telemetry to monitor errors.
Renee: Also recommend we avoid co-announcing with OEM partners until APAC Gaudi stability is confirmed. Keeps messaging simple.
Sam: Agreed. I'll update the public roadmap and add a line: "Regional availability subject to SI certification and driver stability."
MarketingLead: I've scheduled a follow-up sync for 2026-05-02 16:00 UTC: "Marketplace gating & partner announce cadence". Calendar invite sent.
DevOpsBot: Ticket infra#9876 created and assigned to @infra-oncall.
Priya: I'll provision the feature flags and confirm tagging by COB tomorrow.
Carlos: SI will run extended perf on MI300 over the weekend and post results Monday morning.
Renee: If anything shifts I'll escalate to comms and we can hold the press queue.
Sam: Thanks everyone. If APAC Gaudi patch lands earlier lets fast-track the canaries, otherwise we proceed with the staggered windows. Ping me for blockers.
